reason: Defines the exact Workbench file architecture, ownership, navigation, full-data visibility, ordering, state, accessibility and performance contracts that the split must preserve.
Defines SwiftUI component composition and reuse boundaries used to avoid one-component-per-file fragmentation while separating durable owners.
Defines state ownership and data-flow constraints; declaration moves must not introduce new observable models or relocate runtime state semantics.
Defines controller generation, pause/stale, capability, endpoint refresh and mutation safety that all moved Workbench intents must preserve.
Defines controller-reported order, optionality, raw values and capability invariants consumed by the moved presentation/cache layers.
Guides ownership extraction and helper reuse so the refactor does not duplicate logic or create speculative abstractions.
